title: A real photo. The wrong story.
description: Trace an authentic flood photograph whose new caption changes its location and date.
label: Synthetic example

claim.text: This genuine flood photograph was taken in Riverton today, 9 November 2026.
parts: The shared photograph genuinely depicts a flood.
The shared photograph was taken in Riverton on 9 November 2026.

evidence.title: Photographer's authentication note · fictional
evidence.excerpt: In this fictional exercise, the photographer confirms that the supplied picture is an authentic photograph showing flood water. The archive identifies the image and retains its original publication record.
claimParts: The shared photograph genuinely depicts a flood.

evidence.title: Original Eastmere flood photograph, 2021 · fictional
evidence.excerpt: Synthetic original archive record: this exact photograph was published on 4 May 2021 and shows Eastmere Quay. Its original date and location contradict the caption claiming Riverton on 9 November 2026.
claimParts: The shared photograph was taken in Riverton on 9 November 2026.

title: A transit notice with a paper trail.
description: Compare a dated primary announcement with independent reporting on a fictional free-bus day.
label: Synthetic example

claim.text: Riverton municipal buses will be free on 15 November 2026, from 06:00 to 22:00.
parts: Riverton municipal buses will be free on 15 November 2026.
The free service will run from 06:00 to 22:00.

evidence.title: Municipal transport order 2026/41 · fictional
evidence.excerpt: Fictional municipal order: passenger fares on Riverton municipal bus routes are waived on Sunday, 15 November 2026, between 06:00 and 22:00. The order specifies both the date and operating hours.
claimParts: Riverton municipal buses will be free on 15 November 2026.
The free service will run from 06:00 to 22:00.

evidence.title: Reporter confirms free-bus operating window · fictional
evidence.excerpt: For this synthetic example, an independently reported interview with depot managers confirms the no-fare day on 15 November. Supervisors separately confirm the six-in-the-morning start and ten-at-night finish for municipal routes.
claimParts: Riverton municipal buses will be free on 15 November 2026.
The free service will run from 06:00 to 22:00.

title: Two credible sources disagree.
description: Route contradictory bridge-status notices to a human reviewer without guessing a verdict.
label: Synthetic example

claim.text: Rivergate Bridge is closed to all road traffic on 9 November 2026.
parts: Rivergate Bridge is closed to all road traffic on 9 November 2026.

evidence.title: Emergency closure bulletin · fictional
evidence.excerpt: Synthetic emergency bulletin issued at 09:00: Rivergate Bridge is closed to all road traffic on 9 November 2026 until further notice. This fictional source does not record any later reopening.
claimParts: Rivergate Bridge is closed to all road traffic on 9 November 2026.

evidence.title: Bridge operator status at 09:15 · fictional
evidence.excerpt: Fictional operator status panel: Rivergate Bridge is open to normal road traffic as of 09:15 on 9 November 2026. No explanation reconciles this statement with the emergency office closure bulletin.
claimParts: Rivergate Bridge is closed to all road traffic on 9 November 2026.

title: A forward without a source.

claim.text: Riverton Central Library is open until midnight every day starting 9 November 2026.
parts: Riverton Central Library is open until midnight every day starting 9 November 2026.

evidence.title: Community post search snippet · fictional

claimParts: Riverton Central Library is open until midnight every day starting 9 November 2026.

title: Three links. One original rumour.
description: See why copied reports do not count as independent corroboration.
label: Synthetic example

claim.text: Riverton's lantern festival has been cancelled for 2026.
parts: Riverton's lantern festival has been cancelled for 2026.

claimParts: Riverton's lantern festival has been cancelled for 2026.
